overall_goal: Perform various kitchen tasks including writing a recipe, unpacking ingredients, clearing utensils, washing hands, and organizing clean dishes

goals.description: Write down the recipe in the notebook
goals.rationale: The person uses a pen and notebook to write down the recipe they are following.

goals.description: Put away packets into the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person picks up packets from the tabletop and stores them in the upper cabinet.

goals.description: Unpack a tomato and discard the plastic wrappers into the bin
goals.rationale: The person unpacks a tomato, uses a plate to collect the plastic wrappers, and discards them into the bin.

goals.description: Wrap the butter and move it aside
goals.rationale: The person wraps the butter pack and moves it to the side of the gas stove.
The person fills a cup with water from the tap and drinks it.

goals.description: Clear used utensils into the sink
goals.rationale: The person clears a spoon, knife, chopping board, and plate from the workspace into the sink.

goals.description: Wipe the weighing balance and the tabletop
goals.rationale: The person wipes the weighing balance and the tabletop with a tablecloth to clean the workspace.

goals.description: Prepare the sponge with dishwashing liquid and water
goals.rationale: The person applies dishwashing liquid to a sponge and wets it to create foam for washing.
The person pulls up their sleeves, washes their hands under the tap, and dries them with a tablecloth.

goals.description: Organize clean plates and cups from the crockery tray
goals.rationale: The person takes clean plates and cups from the crockery tray and organizes them on the tabletop and cup stand.

goals.description: Put away remaining clean cups, bowls, and a saucepan into the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person takes the remaining clean cups, bowls, and a saucepan from the crockery tray and puts them away in the cabinet.

goals.description: Prepare the sponge with dishwashing liquid again
goals.rationale: The person applies more dishwashing liquid to the sponge and presses it to create foam.
